supersedes.scope: email cost allocation and Formula Engine propagation only

included: Campaign Message and Flow Message recipient-weighted allocation
Formula Engine propagation from raw Dataset V2 facts
excluded: runtime implementation in this contract-only package

source_cost.period_semantics: The estimate is divided by 30 for every closed provider business date; calendar-month length does not change the divisor.

eligible_leaf_rows.eligibility_formula: channel == email AND provider_business_date == allocation_date AND recipients > 0

rounding.residual_rule: After deterministic ordering by canonical leaf identity ascending, assign the rounding residual to the final eligible row.
rounding.invariant_after_rounding: Persisted row spend sums exactly to persisted account-day daily email cost.

no_eligible_recipients.account_day_spend: preserve daily_email_cost exactly once as unallocated email spend

order: calculate and allocate spend in source currency
aggregate raw monetary facts at the requested scope
apply the same canonical FX rate/date/provider provenance once to spend and every monetary fact
run Formula Engine in workspace reporting currency

support_and_aggregation.formula_scope: requested aggregate grain after support-aware raw fact aggregation
support_and_aggregation.double_count_guard: A source fact and allocated spend row may contribute once to an aggregate.

required_steps: Read the current official Klaviyo 2026-10-15 GA documentation.
Revalidate Campaign -> Campaign Message -> Campaign Variation hierarchy.
Prove the identity mapping between Reporting API variation grouping and Campaign Variation API resource identity; never infer equality from labels or names.
Version Dataset V2 identity and Ad Analysis hierarchy contracts only after the mapping is proven.
Define variation-level recipient allocation without duplicating Campaign Message cost.
Test raw-fact and allocated-spend no-double-count invariants.
Run read-only preflight, repository tests and controlled non-empty live acceptance under separate approval gates.

acceptance: For a daily cost of 10 and recipient counts 600, 300 and 100, persisted leaf spend is 6, 3 and 1.
Changing recipient volume changes weights but does not change the account-day daily email cost.
Eligible leaf spend sums exactly to the account-day daily email cost after rounding.
No eligible recipient rows preserve one account-day unallocated cost and create no synthetic leaf.
SMS, MMS and WhatsApp facts receive no share of email cost.
Dataset V2 stores raw facts and allocated spend, not derived Formula Engine KPIs.
Formula Engine computes CPC, ROAS, CPS, Revenue and Revenue Margin from allocated spend at the requested aggregate scope.
CTR, Abandoned and Abandoned Value remain raw-fact formulas at that same aggregate scope.
The 2026-10-15 date alone cannot activate variation-level identity, allocation, backfill or production writes.

rollback.before_runtime_activation: Remove no historical contract; supersede this version with a new versioned decision.
rollback.after_runtime_activation: Feature-flag allocation writes off, keep raw facts and account-day cost auditable, and restore the last accepted allocation contract without deleting historical evidence.
